name: Question 5
problem:
Describe the set $S={...,-24,-19,-14,-9,-4,...}$ using a constructive definition.

*Hint: Take ${a}_{1}=-4$ in the sequence that generates the elements of $S.$*

$$
5n-9
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that the elements of our set

$$
…,\,-24,\,-19,\,-14,\,-9,\,-4,\,…
$$

form a two-way infinite arithmetic sequence with common difference $d=5:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =5 \\  & =-19-(-24) \\  & =-14-(-19) \\  & =-9-(-14) \\  & =⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, setting  ${a}_{1}=-4,$ the $n$th term ${a}_{n}$ of our sequence for $n\in Z$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)\cdot d \\  & =-4+(n-1)\cdot 5 \\  & =-4+5n-5 \\  & =5n-9.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can define our set using a constructive definition as follows:

$$
S={5n-9\,:\,n\in Z}
$$

EXPLANATION

Notice that the elements of our set …,−24,−19,−14,−9,−4,… form a two-way infinite arithmetic sequence with common difference d=5:

d=5=−19−(−24)=−14−(−19)=−9−(−14)=⋯

Therefore, setting a1=−4, the nth term an of our sequence for n∈Z is given by

an=a1+(n−1)⋅d=−4+(n−1)⋅5=−4+5n−5=5n−9.

Therefore, we can define our set using a constructive definition as follows:

S={5n−9:n∈Z}
